summary: Search over 24 polar sites (grade B or C, shipped 2 m skylines) and every 6.5-day sortie start in 2027-2029 for a 21-day shift that flips exactly one verdict in a pair. 97,542 (pair, start date) candidates qualified; the top fifteen tied at score 29. The walked-through candidate is the first of them, 2028-09-05, written up in docs/worked-case.md from this raw output.
selectionNote: All top-scoring candidates tie at 29; the first listed was written up. Tied alternates are recorded in docs/worked-case.md.
